composition.title: Composition
composition.description: Pick a map and 5 agents to see the role balance, community opinion per agent/map, and how you personally perform with these agents on this map.
composition.disclaimer: Indicative score, not a winrate prediction: half role balance (general rules), half community opinions on the best agents per map, frozen as of {{date}}. The meta changes with every patch. An agent not rated "S/A" isn't necessarily bad, just not called out as a top pick by the sources consulted on that date.

notes.noController: No controller: no smoke to block angles, risky on most maps.
notes.noInitiator: No initiator: it can be hard to enter sites without info.
notes.noSentinel: No sentinel: no automatic trap/info, watch flanks manually.
notes.noDuelist: No duelist: possible lack of space-taking/entry power.
notes.tooManyDuelists: Lots of duelists: good pressure, but watch out for a lack of info/support.
notes.balanced: All 4 roles are covered, a balanced composition base.
